title: Analitik Historis & SLA Jaringan Kampus (7 Hari, WIB)

panels.title: Tren Ketersediaan SLA Harian per Gedung (% Waktu Patuh)

targets.rawSql: SELECT (f.date_wib::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS time, b.building_id AS metric, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.is_sla_compliant THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS value FROM warehouse.fact_sla_window f JOIN warehouse.dim_building b ON f.building_key = b.building_key GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Gedung Paling Bermasalah Selama 7 Hari Terakhir

targets.rawSql: SELECT b.building_id AS kode_gedung, b.building_name AS nama_gedung, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT f.is_sla_compliant) AS window_melanggar_sla, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.is_sla_compliant THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS ketersediaan_sla_pct, ROUND(AVG(f.p95_latency_ms)::numeric, 2) AS rata_latensi_p95_ms FROM warehouse.fact_sla_window f JOIN warehouse.dim_building b ON f.building_key = b.building_key GROUP BY b.building_id, b.building_name ORDER BY window_melanggar_sla DESC

panels.title: Rata-Rata Trafik Masuk per Jam per Gedung (Mbps)

targets.rawSql: SELECT t.full_timestamp_utc AS time, b.building_id AS metric, AVG(f.avg_port_in_mbps) AS value FROM warehouse.fact_device_metric_hourly f JOIN warehouse.dim_time t ON f.time_key = t.time_key JOIN warehouse.dim_building b ON f.building_key = b.building_key WHERE f.avg_port_in_mbps IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Kualitas Data: Disisipkan vs Tertangkap (Ledger Rekonsiliasi)

targets.rawSql: SELECT anomaly_type AS jenis_data_kotor, disisipkan_count AS disisipkan, tertangkap_count AS tertangkap, ditangani_count AS ditangani, capture_rate_pct AS persentase_tertangkap FROM warehouse.dq_reconciliation ORDER BY run_timestamp_utc DESC, anomaly_type LIMIT 10
